notes:
CSV integration (2026-07-20): merged fashion_business_resources.csv (30 rows, all 'Section I.1 - Tailoring & Fashion Design') into the pre-existing 2 channels / 1 blog. Two CSV rows were deliberately excluded rather than integrated — flagging here rather than silently dropping: (1) Connect Nigeria (connectnigeria.com/feed/) — this project's own prior research (INTEGRATION_NOTES.md) found articles.connectnigeria.com returning injected gambling/spam content on direct fetch; the CSV's URL is close enough to that flagged domain that it wasn't trusted here without re-confirming, despite the CSV marking it Verified. (2) 'Splice Blog' at splice.ng — the real, already-verified Splice (used in skill_03 and business_08) is a salon/spa booking platform at blog.withsplice.com, not splice.ng; no independent evidence splice.ng exists or is related, so this looks like a mix-up rather than a real fashion-business blog. Two more CSV rows had no working feed/ID to integrate cleanly and are noted here instead: Vivo Fashion Group / Wandia Gichuru — a real Stanford GSB 'Grit & Growth' podcast episode profiling a Pan-African fashion brand, but no dedicated feed. Seedstars 'Fashion Futures' — a real African incubator for fashion designers with business training, web link only, no feed. Also worth knowing: a free Shopify fashion business-plan TEMPLATE (not a book) is available at shopify.com/business/business-plan-template — left out of the Books list since it isn't a book, but genuinely useful. Channel IDs for Kemafrik, Stylebyreme, and Insight With D'ara were not usable in the CSV (RSS_Feed column had a truncated placeholder, 'channel_id=UC...') and were independently resolved via FeedSpot/NoxInfluencer directory listings, cross-checked against each channel's own bio.

Round 2 (2026-07-20, same day): user asked to close the gap toward 10/10/10. Added 3 more channels after screening ~15 candidates from Heepsy/FeedSpot/SpeakRJ Nigeria-fashion-YouTuber directories — only kept ones whose own channel bio explicitly frames content around the business side (pricing, client acquisition, turning skill into income), same bar as the original 5. Most candidates screened were pure style/tutorial or media/entertainment channels with no business framing, so they were left out rather than added just to hit a number — this appears to be a genuinely small pool, consistent with the CSV itself only surfacing 5 to begin with. Channels are now 8/10, not 10/10; open to another pass if a specific channel is known to be missing. Books are now 10/10 with one more free ebook found via direct search (Human B — legitimate, verified live). Also worth flagging: several search results pointed to Fashionary's 'Fashion Business Manual' as a 'free PDF' on Scribd/PDFCoffee — that book is commercially sold by Fashionary (fashionary.org/products/fbm, also on Amazon), so those are unauthorized copies and were deliberately not used here.

Round 3 (2026-07-20, same day): found 2 more via a different angle — searching for dedicated 'fashion business coach' channels rather than Nigerian fashion-designer channels that happen to mention business. Both are global/US-UK-based, not Nigeria-specific — flagging that honestly, since it's a real shift from the first 8. Went this route because the Nigeria-specific pool genuinely topped out at 8 after ~20 candidates screened across two research sessions. These 2 are fully dedicated fashion-business-coaching channels (not mixed craft+business), well-corroborated by independent sources (podcast interviews, press mentions), which made them a stronger fit than padding with more Nigerian style/tutorial channels that lack real business content. Channels, blogs, and books are now all 10/10. Set status to 'complete' — first time this category has hit the full target; adjust the status string if the app expects a different exact value.

Books audit (2026-07-30): 9 of 10 book URLs were broken (404s, blank/black screens, or wrong-page loads — confirmed in-app testing). All 9 repaired; 1 kept as-is (SBA). Fixes: (1) OpenStax → openstax.org/details/books/entrepreneurship. (2) Mary Gehlhar → archive.org (Internet Archive borrow). (3) Frances Harder → archive.org (Internet Archive borrow). (4) Freelance guide had no free standalone copy online — replaced with fashionbizinc.org (Frances Harder's non-profit with free resources). (5) SBA URL kept unchanged. (6) E-Myth Revisited → archive.org (free PDF confirmed). (7) Profit First → archive.org (Internet Archive borrow). (8) Built to Sell /resources 404'd — updated to root domain builttosell.com. (9) HubSpot resource deleted — replaced with hubspot.com/resources/startups. (10) Human B /free-ebook 404'd — updated to humanb.com/fashion-business-resources.
